questions.question: In a code language, SILVER is written as JDQMXQ and WISDOM is written as IDRJXR. How will KENSTAR be written as in that language?
questions.solution: [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c83a9b3f9d49fc4cf9c114c5bcbdc1a5d91d619f564cf91e88a3dcf504917f15.png] Given: SILVER is written as JDQMXQ and WISDOM is written as IDRJXR. The logic followed here is: **1) Given letters in a word are arranged in alphabetical order i.e. A to Z.** **2) then each letter is increased or decreased by +5, & -5 successively.** SILVER is written as JDQMXQ. 1) SILVER → Alphabetical order → EILRSV. 2) Each letter +5, -5 so on.

questions.question: In a certain code language, BEYOND is written as BDFNPY. How will PROMISE be written in that language?
questions.solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/7fc278fe789af8222fe6cac882237358a9d0a2182b555ce3565db4085f8b1202.png] 

The logic followed here is 

Logic:

Step 1:- Vowels are increased by +1.

Step 2:- Consonants are placed as it is.

Step 3:- Arrange the letters in alphabetical order (Increasing order of positional value).

BEYOND → BDFNPY

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/9dacd73a184d9623672da5eba9ec41c9c401c3444a571c7a5c7295ec949019ec.png] 

If we arrange the resultant letters in alphabetical order, we get BDFNPY.

Similarly,

For PROMISE,

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/eb0d52e9ad694332ceb79f733ff37adf3ae89e5b809f59c80fe30af87af2c917.png] 

If we arrange the resultant letters in alphabetical order, we get FJMPPRS.

Hence, the code for the word PROMISE is **"FJMPPRS"**.

questions.question: In a certain code language, 'MODERATE' is written as 'OQEFTBVF' and 'LIFE' is written as 'NJGF'. How will 'CLEAR' be written in that language?
questions.solution:
The table is alphabets place value:

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/259d8630a9ac11653540776fb8c878efe7c7e39d2fafd27847036c083bb6c14d.png] 

The pattern followed here is:

**If alphabet place value more than 10 then is coded as __second next alphabet__.**​

__
 
• **Place value more than 10 + 2 = letter**

If alphabet place value less than 10 then is coded as next alphabet__.

 
• Place value less than 10 + 1 = letter

'MODERATE' is written as 'OQEFTBVF'

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/5553fd16acf502a0fb1bec5b299805a6464d17d94e746951a5d79fb3935b6426.png] 

And,

 'LIFE' is written as 'NJGF'

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/7e1e36df79f0fbd1223b33b9b6eefa7a4ccf6e23d91208deb9bf56ebb1d88201.png] 

Similarly,

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/6370c711d51011d0518c9c353f9df407b086bbdbd94d02db974c2245f41ecb53.png] 

Hence, 'CLEAR' is coded as "**DNFBT**".

questions.question: In a certain language, 'salute' is written as 'iuamet'. How will 'mango' be written in that language?
questions.solution:
Given;

salute → iuamet, mango → ?

Logic: Criss cross format. Vowel - next vowel, Consonant - +1 

salute → iuamet

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/d1812377568eed6c98dd173f8699c05090d118f661cc42f90795f2751a761171.png] 

Similarly,

mango → uhoen

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/34df718a074964922f1e2c39cbe085d07fbda9a55bc82404d340bfa9bfbc18be.png] 

Hence, mango is coded as **uhoen**.
